image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked meatloaf sitting inside a rectangular aluminum foil baking pan. The meatloaf is oblong and domed, covered in a thick, glossy red glaze (likely ketchup or tomato sauce). There is a noticeable lighter, yellowish patch on the right side of the loaf where the glaze appears thinner or broken. The background shows a dark countertop and a hint of an orange wall.
